data.body_html:
Combine the glamour of a Marbella yacht charter for Starlite 2030 with a pre-concert cruise that sets the tone for an unforgettable evening. Depart from Puerto Banús, enjoy sunset over the Mediterranean, and arrive at the Starlite Auditorium in Nagüeles relaxed and ready. Our guide covers timing, boat options, and practical tips to make your night seamless.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works for Starlite 2030

Starlite concerts start at 22:00, giving you a perfect window for a 2-hour cruise from 17:00–19:00 or 18:00–20:00. The golden hour light on the water, a glass of cava, and the sound of waves replace pre-show queues. Puerto Banús is just 8 km from the venue — a 15-minute taxi ride. No rush, no stress.

Boat Options for Your Starlite Charter

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús. For couples or small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal at €749 for 2 hours (all inclusive). For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Browse our full fleet for more options.

Sample Pre-Concert Itinerary

  • 17:00 — Board at Puerto Banús, meet skipper, safety briefing.
  • 17:15 — Cruise east toward Cabopino or west toward Cala del Faro.
  • 18:00 — Anchor for a swim stop (weather permitting).
  • 18:30 — Snacks and drinks as sun sets behind La Concha.
  • 19:00 — Return to port, freshen up.
  • 20:30 — Taxi to Starlite Auditorium (15 min).
  • 21:00 — Arrive, enjoy the show.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every booking comes with: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. Just turn up at Puerto Banús. Check availability for your Starlite date.

Practical Tips for Concert Goers

  • Book early: Starlite 2030 tickets sell fast; boats follow suit. Reserve 1–2 weeks ahead.
  • Dress smart casual: Boat attire is relaxed, but the concert venue is open-air — bring a jacket for 22:00–01:00.
  • Arrive at the marina 15 minutes early: Parking near Puerto Banús is limited; consider a taxi.
  • Stay hydrated: We provide drinks, but bring extra water for the outdoor venue.
  • Use WhatsApp for booking: Quickest way to confirm your boat and ask questions.
